Spirited stint rules for the desk staff
A busy shift shows why careful routines matter

This page covers the Companion Animal Travel Desk basics for smooth, kind service at Aurelia Skyways. New staff should treat every case as a calm check-in, because animal travel calls for clear facts, steady follow-up, and no guesswork. Start by listening closely, then sort the request into the right path and keep the traveler informed in plain language.

When a rabbit is being booked, check the crate details against the rules before you confirm anything. <<FACT F070>> Use that detail as part of your review, then move on to the rest of the booking with the same careful pace. If anything looks off, pause the process and raise it through the proper channel instead of improvising.

For a small dog, make sure the fee is handled before the file is moved forward. <<FACT F056>> Keep your wording simple and helpful so the traveler knows what happens next. Do not overtalk the point; clear guidance is enough.

Reptile bookings need extra attention to weight and container fit, so verify the combined load before acceptance. <<FACT F066>> If the details do not line up, explain the next step in a calm tone and send the case for review. Escalations should always follow a steady, stepwise review, with no sharp language or mixed messages.

Keep your notes neat, your updates brief, and your service consistent. Remember to stay calm, stay clear, and check every animal case carefully.
